source_documents.title: Tuning the dual emission of keto/enol forms of excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) emitters via intramolecular charge transfer (ICT)

reference_evidence_units.quote: 6b displays one emission peak at 530 nm with a large Stokes shift in toluene
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6b
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Toluene compared with the O-methyl control 5b.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The target's single red-shifted emission is assigned to the keto form.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Control 5b emits at 430 nm as reported on the following page; SI control spectra not independently checked.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the energy levels of TS* of 6b is close to its S1(enol) energy
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6b
reference_evidence_units.statement: The low forward barrier and more difficult reverse transfer favor the keto form.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Static excited-state energies do not establish a transfer timescale.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the two local ICT effects from TPA to the ESIPT- resulting keto carbonyl group and from the tautomeric enamine to TPB
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6b
reference_evidence_units.statement: Local charge redistribution is used to explain keto stabilization.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Keep local ICT distinct from an overall CT-dominated emitting state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: there are no obvious dipole moment changes from the ground state to the excited state for the keto forms of 6b and 6c
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6b keto form and 6c keto form
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source does not assign distinct overall ICT character to the keto emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This limits but does not negate the source's local-ICT interpretation.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 6a, 6b, 6c, and 6d in polystyrene (PS) film exhibit similar emission spectra to those in toluene
reference_evidence_units.subject: 6a-6d
reference_evidence_units.conditions: 5 wt% polystyrene films, Table 1 and reported SI Figure S16.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The source reports similar solution and film spectral patterns.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Film preparation alone does not establish host confinement as the mechanism. OLED tests are only for 6a/6c.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain only local ICT used to stabilize the keto state, with the absence of a distinct overall CT emission explicitly recorded.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keto emission and the calculated forward/reverse barriers are the core source explanation.
